svg.title: How Kapitsa works
svg.desc: It guesses ahead, then checks in one go: A small draft model guesses the next few words. The big model checks them all in one pass and keeps the ones it agrees with, so each pass writes several words instead of one. GPU, hand-written metal code: Every layer runs on GPU code made for these exact models and for Apple silicon, not a general-purpose framework. Neural Engine, helps read long prompts: On the dense models it reads part of each prompt beside the GPU, so a long file or chat loads sooner. Memory, keeps conversations ready: Each conversation keeps what it has already read, so a follow-up only reads the new message. Up to 4 run at once.
